status: read-only reusable-CFEL proposal; not adopted and not a runtime/parser result
scope: Formalize the existing Atom.Content.Claim rules for at most one CFEL fenced block and no other fenced blocks. A user decision remains pending on four-space-indented code blocks.

live_claim.unchanged_contract: Atom/(.Role in RMED).Content.Claim{:1}: [markdown]{:1}; Atom/(.Role in RMED).Content.Claim.*[]{:0}

reusable_markdown_structure_rule_candida.title: Select parsed Markdown code blocks
rule_text: For a Property value p in Format [markdown], MARKDOWN_FENCED_BLOCKS(p) selects the fenced code-block structures in the complete parse of that scalar value. MARKDOWN_INDENTED_BLOCKS(p) selects indentation-based code-block structures. These selections are parsed Markdown value structures, not CAPRMEDIO Graph Nodes and not authored dependent Properties.
INFO_STRING(b) returns the exact info string attached to fenced block b, including the empty string when no info string is present. It does not inspect or validate the block's contents.
COUNT(selection) returns the number of selected parsed blocks. ALL(b IN selection, predicate) holds when the predicate holds for every selected block; it holds for an empty selection.

The parser must provide a complete parse of the entire Markdown scalar value. Missing, incomplete, or unresolved parsed structure is an evaluation error and cannot satisfy a constraint by being treated as an empty selection.

These operations inspect block boundaries and fenced-block info strings only. CFEL syntax inside a CFEL-labelled block is checked separately by the CFEL syntax rules. Other block languages and ordinary Markdown text are not interpreted as CFEL.
reusable_markdown_structure_rule_candida.candidate_notation: COUNT(MARKDOWN_FENCED_BLOCKS(p)) <= n; ALL(b IN MARKDOWN_FENCED_BLOCKS(p), INFO_STRING(b) = "label")
scope_guards: Each invocation receives one scalar Markdown Property value; it does not bind or recurse through the Property's dependent Properties.
COUNT and ALL are generic parsed-value operations, not a Claim-specific VALID_CLAIM predicate.
No graph Node, Atom field, or recursive Property binding is introduced.
reusable_markdown_structure_rule_candida.implementation_boundary: This is a candidate CFEL capability. It does not claim that a parser exists, has been selected, or is used by runtime validation.

consumer_policy_variants.user_answer_required: If four-space-indented code blocks are allowed and only fenced blocks are restricted.
consumer_policy_variants.formal_candidate: COUNT(MARKDOWN_FENCED_BLOCKS(Atom/(.Role in RMED).Content.Claim)) <= 1; ALL(b IN MARKDOWN_FENCED_BLOCKS(Atom/(.Role in RMED).Content.Claim), INFO_STRING(b) = "CFEL")
consumer_policy_variants.result: Zero fenced blocks are allowed. If a fenced block exists, there can be at most one and its exact info string must be CFEL. Indented code blocks are outside this selection and remain allowed.
consumer_policy_variants.p_binding: For this declaration, p is each selected Atom.Content.Claim scalar value; each invocation parses that one value only.

consumer_policy_variants.user_answer_required: If four-space-indented code blocks are also forbidden.
consumer_policy_variants.formal_candidate: COUNT(MARKDOWN_FENCED_BLOCKS(Atom/(.Role in RMED).Content.Claim)) <= 1; ALL(b IN MARKDOWN_FENCED_BLOCKS(Atom/(.Role in RMED).Content.Claim), INFO_STRING(b) = "CFEL"); COUNT(MARKDOWN_INDENTED_BLOCKS(Atom/(.Role in RMED).Content.Claim)) = 0
consumer_policy_variants.result: Zero or one fenced block is allowed and it must have exact info string CFEL; no indentation-based code block is allowed.
consumer_policy_variants.p_binding: For this declaration, p is each selected Atom.Content.Claim scalar value; each invocation parses that one value only.

counterexamples.input_shape: A fenced block with no info string: ```\ntext\n```
counterexamples.fenced_blocks_only: fails: the empty exact info string is not CFEL
counterexamples.fenced_and_indented: fails: the empty exact info string is not CFEL

counterexamples.input_shape: Two fenced blocks, each with exact info string CFEL

counterexamples.fenced_blocks_only: fails: exact info string is not CFEL
counterexamples.fenced_and_indented: fails: exact info string is not CFEL

counterexamples.input_shape: One four-space-indented code block and no fences
counterexamples.fenced_blocks_only: passes these fence-only constraints: the indented block is not selected
counterexamples.fenced_and_indented: fails: indented-block count is not zero

counterexamples.input_shape: Ordinary prose with no code blocks
counterexamples.fenced_blocks_only: passes: zero fences and the universal label condition is vacuously true
counterexamples.fenced_and_indented: passes: zero fences and zero indented code blocks

counterexamples.input_shape: The selected Markdown scalar cannot be completely parsed or its block structure is unavailable
counterexamples.fenced_blocks_only: evaluation error; it does not pass as an empty selection
counterexamples.fenced_and_indented: evaluation error; it does not pass as an empty selection

counterexamples.input_shape: One well-formed fenced block labelled CFEL whose body contains invalid CFEL syntax
counterexamples.fenced_blocks_only: passes the Markdown structure checks; fails separately under CFEL syntax validation
counterexamples.fenced_and_indented: passes the Markdown structure checks if no indented blocks are present; fails separately under CFEL syntax validation

counterexamples.input_shape: One fenced block whose exact info string is `CFEL extra`
counterexamples.fenced_blocks_only: fails: the exact info string is not CFEL
counterexamples.fenced_and_indented: fails: the exact info string is not CFEL

existing_cfelfence_rule.evidence: A CFEL-labelled fence carries formal content inside RMED Claim. It does not currently count fences or constrain info strings.

existing_value_child_rule.evidence: Markdown values and dependent Property-name constraints are separate; Claim.* remains zero.
